title: 21st Amendment Brewery
specs: Amendment Lager is a bright light straw color beer with soft malt and a quiet hop character.
Brew Free or Die! IPA is a West Coast Style IPA with golden malts and new world hops.
Brew Free Or Die! Blood Orange IPA brewed with real blood oranges and citrusy dry hops.
Brew Free! Or Die Hazy IPA is a New England Style IPA with turbid pale color and fruity aroma.
El Sully is a Mexican-style lager available year-round in six pack cans and on draft.
